content: PWA offline pitfalls: don't cache Dexie/IndexedDB in SW—IDB is app-layer source of truth. Version cache names; delete old caches on activate. Avoid auto skipWaiting—prompt user before reload on SW update. Precached shell can serve stale JS until new SW activates; pair precache with updatefound UI. Record app build + schema version together. Offline SPA needs network-first for navigation or user-triggered reload after deploy.
